## Introduction

The purpose of this script is to compare the two standalone derivations of the 
primary analysis of the primary endpoint for the primary estimand, each programmed 
independently by Rune Haubo B Christensen (RHBC), senior statistician, and Eva Nina S 
Wandall (ENSW), statistician, with reference to the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP).

The outputs from the parallel programming are further compared with the result 
generated by the automated pipeline during the production of the TLF book.

The specification of the expected output target, as well as paths to input data and the 
output files, is provided in the Excel file `parallel_programming_output_target.xlsx`, 
located in the current folder.

The `comparedf` function from the `arsenal` package is used to compare outputs. 
Numerical values are compared to four significant digits. **R** version and package
versions are documented via `sessionInfo()` in the Appendix.

The script includes a `stop_on_error` parameter in the YAML header. When set to 
`TRUE`, `stop` calls halt execution if discrepancies are detected between
the two independently programmed outputs, or between the outputs and the result 
included in the TLF book. If set to `FALSE`, a report of discrepancies is generated 
instead. If no discrepancies are found, the script concludes that the outputs are identical.
The value of the `stop_on_error` parameter is currently set to:
```{r, collapse=TRUE}
params$stop_on_error
```


## Setup

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(data.table)
library(arsenal)

source("20_functions/source_dir.R")
source_dir("20_functions") # for the render_multiple_rmd function
```

Define a function controlling the numerical precision of the comparison, such that 
values are considered equal if they agree to four significant digits. This function
is passed to `comparedf.control()` for use in the `comparedf()` function. 
```{r}
# NB: tol is required in the function by comparedf() even though it is not used
tol.num.sign <- function(x, y, tol){
  idx <- signif(x, 4) != signif(y, 4)
  tol.NA(x, y, idx)
}
cntl <- comparedf.control(tol.num = tol.num.sign)
```

Define a function that checks whether two data.tables are identical in dimensions
and content, i.e. have the same number of rows and columns and with all compared values equal.
```{r}
check_equality <- function(dt1, dt2, control = cntl){
  cmp <- comparedf(dt1, dt2, control = control)
  cmp_dt <- as.data.table(summary(cmp)$comparison.summary.table)
  
  # Check that the expected summary statistics are present exactly once
  stopifnot(
    nrow(cmp_dt[statistic == "Number of variables compared with all values equal"]) == 1,
    nrow(cmp_dt[statistic == "Number of observations with all compared variables equal"]) == 1
  )
  
  res <- ncol(dt1) == ncol(dt2) & 
         nrow(dt1) == nrow(dt2) &
         cmp_dt[statistic == "Number of variables compared with all values equal"]$value == ncol(dt1) & 
         cmp_dt[statistic == "Number of observations with all compared variables equal"]$value == nrow(dt1) 
  res
}
```

## Generate and load inputs for comparisons

Load the paths to the input data and the output files, as specified in the 
*Data_paths* sheet of the `parallel_programming_output_target.xlsx`.
```{r}
data_paths <- read_excel("80_parallel_programming/parallel_programming_output_target.xlsx", sheet = "Data_paths")
setDT(data_paths)

# Path to the raw trial data extracted from REDCap
raw_trial_data_path <- data_paths[data == "raw_trial_data"]$path
# Path to the treatment allocation data
treatment_data_path <- data_paths[data == "treatment_data"]$path
# Path to the output generated by ENSW
output_ensw_path <- data_paths[data == "output_ensw"]$path
# Path to the output generated by RHBC
output_rhbc_path <- data_paths[data == "output_rhbc"]$path
```

Render the independent analysis conducted by ENSW
```{r}
# Render the script by ENSW
render_multiple_rmd("10_independent_programming_ensw.Rmd", 
                    path = "80_parallel_programming",
                    params = list(raw_trial_data_path = raw_trial_data_path,
                                  treatment_data_path = treatment_data_path,
                                  output_path = output_ensw_path))

# Read output file
output_ensw <- readRDS(output_ensw_path)

# # Ensure that the output file was actually updated within the last 5 seconds,
# i.e. that rendering successfully generated a new file
if (file.info(output_ensw_path)$mtime < Sys.time() - 5){
  stop(paste(output_ensw_path, "was not updated during rendering"))
} 
```

Render the independent analysis conducted by RHBC
```{r}
# Render the script by RHBC
render_multiple_rmd("11_independent_programming_rhbc.Rmd", 
                    path = "80_parallel_programming",
                    params = list(raw_trial_data_path = raw_trial_data_path,
                                  treatment_data_path = treatment_data_path,
                                  output_path = output_rhbc_path))


# Read output file
output_rhbc <- readRDS(output_rhbc_path)

# # Ensure that the output file was actually updated within the last 5 seconds,
# i.e. that rendering successfully generated a new file
if (file.info(output_rhbc_path)$mtime < Sys.time() - 5){
  stop(paste(output_rhbc_path, "was not updated during rendering"))
} 
```

Look up the relevant row in the metadata file, then load the corresponding table 
as include in the TLF book.
```{r}
# Identify analysis from metadata
tlf_reg <- get_metadata()[estimand == "policy" & 
                       outcome_var == "madrs_total10" & 
                       visit == 7 &
                       data_name == "chgbl" & 
                       role == "Primary"]

# Analysis included in the TLF book
tlf_raw <- get_dt_table(tlf_reg)
```


## Comparison of independently programmed analyses

Summary of the comparison of the two independently programmed analyses
```{r}
comparedf(output_rhbc, output_ensw, control = cntl)
```

Binary conclusion of equality based on the check_equality() function
```{r}
cmp1 <- check_equality(output_rhbc, output_ensw)
cmp1
```

```{r, eval = params$stop_on_error, echo=params$stop_on_error}
if (cmp1 == FALSE) 
  stop("Discrepancies between the two independently programmed outputs.")
```

`r if (cmp1 == TRUE) "The independently programmed outputs agree within the specified numeric tolerance of 4 significant digits. The shared output is presented below" else "Discrepancies were found between the two independently programmed outputs. Please review the differences below:"`

```{r, eval = !cmp1, echo = !cmp1}
summary(comparedf(output_rhbc, output_ensw, control = cntl))
```

`r if (!cmp1) "The output from RHBC:"`

```{r output1}
output_rhbc
```

`r if (!cmp1) "The output from ENSW:"`

```{r, eval = !cmp1, echo = !cmp1}
output_ensw
```


## Comparison with the TLF book analysis

`r if (cmp1 == FALSE) "No comparison with the table included in the TLF book is performed since the independently programmed outputs do not agree." else "Format the analysis included in the TLF book in accordance with the target output specified in *parallel_programming_output_target.xlsx*"`

```{r, eval = cmp1, echo = cmp1}
# Format visit and treatment columns in accordance with the output target
tlf_raw[, c_visit := paste("Day", gsub("day", "", f_visit))]
tlf_raw[, trt := factor(trt)]
tlf_raw[, trt := relevel(trt, ref = grep("^[Pp]lacebo", levels(trt), value = TRUE))]

# Keep only relevant columns 
out_tlf <- tlf_raw[, .(trt, c_visit, FAS, N, Miss, emmean, SE.emmean, 
                       lower.CL.emmean, upper.CL.emmean, `Est. Mean (95% CI)`, 
                       estimate, SE, lower.CL, upper.CL, `Effect (95% CI)`, 
                       p.value, `p-value`)][c_visit == "Day 7"]

# Rename columns in accordance with the output target
setnames(out_tlf, colnames(out_tlf), colnames(output_rhbc))
```

`r if (cmp1 == TRUE) "Summary of the comparison of the output from the independently programmed analyses and the result included in the TLF book"`
```{r, eval = cmp1, echo = cmp1}
comparedf(output_rhbc, out_tlf)
```

`r if (cmp1 == TRUE) "Binary conclusion of equality based on the check_equality() function"`
```{r, eval = cmp1, echo = cmp1}
cmp2 <- check_equality(output_rhbc, out_tlf)
cmp2
```

```{r, eval = params$stop_on_error, echo=params$stop_on_error}
if (cmp2 == FALSE) 
  stop("Discrepancies between the two independently programmed outputs and the table included in the TLF book")
```

`r if (cmp1 == TRUE) {if (cmp2 == TRUE) "The independently programmed outputs agree with the result included in the TLF book." else "Discrepancies were found between the two independently programmed outputs and the result included in the TLF book. Please review the differences below:"}`

```{r, eval = cmp1 && !cmp2, echo = cmp1 && !cmp2}
summary(comparedf(output_rhbc, out_tlf, control = cntl))
```

`r if (cmp1 == TRUE && cmp2 == FALSE) "The analysis output included in the TLF book:"`

```{r, eval = cmp1 && !cmp2, echo = cmp1 && !cmp2}
out_tlf
```
